book_exercises.subtitle_fa: تمرین‌های این بخش را کامل کنید. هر تمرین دکمهٔ «بررسی پاسخ» خودش را دارد.
book_exercises.subtitle_en: Complete the exercises below. Each exercise has its own Check Answer button.

instruction.en: Complete the table using will: affirmative, negative, and question forms.
instruction.fa: با استفاده از will جدول را کامل کن: مثبت، منفی و پرسشی.

items.text: She ___ (go / not go) to the mountain?

instruction.en: Write future-tense sentences using these beginnings. Then ask a friend questions about the future with When, Where, and Who.
instruction.fa: با استفاده از این شروع‌ها جمله بساز: On Friday morning, I ... / Next week, my brother ... / Tomorrow afternoon, ... سپس با یک دوست، با کلمات When / Where / Who دربارهٔ آینده سؤال بپرس.

items.question: On Friday morning, I ...
items.sample_answer: On Friday morning, I will visit my grandparents.

items.question: Next week, my brother ...
items.sample_answer: Next week, my brother will study for his exam.

items.question: Tomorrow afternoon, ...
items.sample_answer: Tomorrow afternoon, I will meet my friend.

items.question: Write three questions to ask a friend about the future: one with When, one with Where, and one with Who.

instruction.en: Complete each sentence with the correct form of be going to.
instruction.fa: جمله‌ها را با شکل درست going to کامل کن.

items.text: Reza (not / watch) ______ TV. The program is boring.

instruction.en: Choose the best verb form to complete the passage.
instruction.fa: بهترین فعل را برای کامل کردن متن انتخاب کن.

passage.en: Alfredo is an Italian tourist. He (1) ______ in Rome. He (2) ______ to travel and see different places of the world. He (3) ______ photos especially of animals. Next month, he and his wife (4) ______ to Iran. They (5) ______ to Tooran Plain to see animals. After two weeks, they (6) ______ some beautiful cities in Iran.
passage.fa: آلفردو یک گردشگر ایتالیایی است. او در رم (1) ______. او (2) ______ به سفر و دیدن مکان‌های مختلف جهان. او مخصوصاً از حیوانات عکس (3) ______. ماه آینده او و همسرش به ایران (4) ______. آن‌ها برای دیدن حیوانات به دشت توران (5) ______. پس از دو هفته، آن‌ها از چند شهر زیبای ایران (6) ______.
